summary: CHANGE-PASSWORD FEATURE + BRAND COLOR FULLY VERIFIED (backend 14/14 pytest, frontend ~20 UI checks, all pass). Backend POST /api/auth/change-password: empty fields 400, new<6 chars 400 ('minimal 6 karakter'), same-as-old 400 ('harus berbeda'), wrong old 401 ('Kata sandi lama salah'), success returns rotated session_token with message 'Kata sandi berhasil diubah', ALL old sessions revoked (2 pre-existing tokens both 401 on /auth/me), new token valid, old password login rejected, new password login accepted. Frontend: /login store-name computed style = rgb(168, 85, 247) Poppins-SemiBold (soft purple, bold look) — PASS; admin drawer brand title 'Diana Stuff' also rgb(168, 85, 247) Poppins-SemiBold — PASS; new drawer item 'Kata Sandi' (drawer-sandi) renders with shield-key icon and navigates to /dashboard/sandi; all 4 client validations show correct Indonesian errors via password-error testID; wrong-old-password surfaces backend 401 message in UI; success flow via UI shows green toast 'Kata sandi berhasil diubah', clears all 3 fields, persists rotated token (dashboard still accessible after full page reload — session persistence verified); old password UI login rejected with 'Username atau password salah', new password UI login lands on /home. Password changed to temp via UI then RESTORED to admin123 via UI (toast confirmed); final curl confirms admin/admin123 and buyer/buyer123 both login 200. Regression: buyer whitelist login lands on /toko, buyer+admin logout work, Google tab/button unaffected. INCIDENT FOUND & FIXED (data, not code): the seeded 'buyer' account had deleted_at set (soft-deleted by an earlier admin-customer test), causing buyer login 401 — restored deleted_at=null/status=approved in MongoDB; buyer regression now passes.
action_items: No blocking issues — feature complete and verified end-to-end.
Caution for future tests: admin 'Pelanggan' delete flow soft-deletes users; never delete the seeded 'buyer' account (it broke buyer123 login until restored).

Optional: Playwright web cannot rely on a stable hamburger selector (react-navigation renders it as aria-label 'Show navigation menu'); coordinate click works. Consider adding testID to drawer toggle for future automation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py change-password: correct order of checks, bcrypt verify against fresh DB doc, delete_many revokes ALL user sessions then rotates token — verified live.
sandi.tsx: onSuccess persists rotated token via persistToken before clearing fields — verified session survives reload. Client-side validations match backend messages.
Brand color uses colors.brandPrimary (single theme token) — change propagates consistently to login store-name, drawer brand title, and accent UI (verified rgb(168, 85, 247) in both places).
No deprecated Expo packages in reviewed files; no HTML elements; all interactive elements have testIDs.
Dashboard drawer hamburger on web is react-navigation's default toggle (aria-label 'Show navigation menu'), no testID — testability nit only.
updated_files: MongoDB: users{buyer}.deleted_at=null, status=approved (restored soft-deleted seeded account)
seed_data_creation: Restored soft-deleted seeded buyer account. Admin password cycled admin123 -> TEST_newpass789 -> admin123 (pytest) and admin123 -> UITest2026x -> admin123 (UI); final state verified admin123.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin home button testID is 'open-dashboard-button' (not dashboard-button). Drawer hamburger: click coordinates (25,33) at 375x667 viewport or aria-label 'Show navigation menu'. If buyer/buyer123 ever 401s, check deleted_at in Mongo first (soft-delete hazard).
rca_of_issue: Buyer login regression failure: login-whitelist filters deleted_at=None; the seeded buyer doc had deleted_at set (soft-deleted, most likely by a previous admin-customer management test). Hash still matched buyer123. Mitigation: restored deleted_at=null; recommend tests avoid deleting seeded accounts or restore them in teardown.
